comment: Underwriting rules for the Underwriting page (web/underwriting.html, web/underwriting.js). Owner, 2026-10-26: quote the longest program for the enrolled debt, always; to lower the price, remove a credit card (smallest first, two at most), never a shorter length. Minimum enrolled debt $7,000 (owner, 2026-10-26, matching Cordoba). Rules from Cordoba's WC Guidelines workbook (unacceptable creditors, debt types, requirements; list dated July 03 2026) plus the owner's additions, and config/playbook/Knowledge_Card.md section 4. The page runs only in the rep's browser: nothing about the client is sent or saved.

secured.label: Secured loan or secured card
secured.reason: Secured debt does not qualify (Cordoba's one exception: a loan secured only by small household items, with a note on the file).

mortgage.label: Mortgage or home equity
mortgage.reason: Mortgages and home equity do not qualify.

home_improvement.label: Home improvement or solar loan
home_improvement.reason: Home improvement and solar loans do not qualify (lien rights on the home).

student.label: Student loan
student.reason: Student loans do not qualify, private or federal, even in collections.

tax.label: IRS or tax debt
tax.reason: IRS and tax debt do not qualify.

utility.label: Utility
utility.reason: Utilities do not qualify, even in collections.

insurance.label: Insurance company
insurance.reason: Insurance company debt does not qualify, even in collections.

lease.label: Lease, rent to own, or lease to own
lease.reason: Leases and rent to own do not qualify.

other_excluded.label: Other excluded (overdraft, cash advance, child support, judgment fees, security system, car rental or EZPass, funeral, SBA, farm, trading platform)
other_excluded.reason: Cordoba does not accept this kind of debt.

notes: The client must have made at least one payment on each debt.
No accounts in active litigation without the lawsuit reviewed first (Cordoba adds $550 at enrollment if they can help).
Bankruptcy accounts only if the report shows dismissed.
Age limit 90 for the client and co-applicant.
Street address only, no PO Box. Credit report under 30 days old and not frozen.
A co-applicant needs a shared debt unless they are legally married.
